verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents organization collections, members and groups (managed via the Public API) and an integrated TOTP generator for logins. A paying team user confirms that account sharing works, including 2FA. However, the evidence never documents per-member or per-collection permission levels, nor shows that TOTP seeds sync to collection members. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of collection sharing with granular per-member permissions (e.g., read-only or hidden passwords), explicit docs that shared items carry TOTP to members.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control

citations.quote: The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs), six-digit codes using SHA-1 that rotate every 30 seconds
The killer feature for me has been safer account sharing, including 2FA.
